name: Your Company
tagline: A second life for your favourite sofa

listing.description: A website for a reupholstery workshop: services as pattern pieces, stages on a tape measure, figures on tags, prices and call-out requests sent to Telegram.

seo.title: Your Company — furniture reupholstery in Tashkent
seo.description: Reupholstering sofas, armchairs and chairs, replacing foam and springs, restoring wooden parts. Free pickup and delivery, from 5 days, 1-year warranty.
seo.answer: Your Company is a reupholstery and restoration workshop in Tashkent (60 Katartal St), Mon–Sat 09:00–18:00. Sofa reupholstery from 1,600,000 UZS, armchair from 750,000 UZS, chair from 180,000 UZS including fabric. Free pickup and delivery, 5–10 days, 1-year warranty.

sections.title: Don’t throw it out — we’ll reupholster it
sections.subtitle: New fabric, fresh foam and strong springs in the old reliable frame. We pick it up ourselves and bring it back in 5–10 days.

items.title: Sofa reupholstery
items.text: New fabric, foam and wadding; we check and reinforce the frame.

items.title: Armchair reupholstery
items.text: Including button tufting and decorative nails.

items.title: Chairs as a set
items.text: Seats and backs; six chairs in a week.

items.title: Wood restoration
items.text: Sanding, toning and lacquering arms and legs.

sections.label: About
sections.title: A beech frame outlives three upholsteries
sections.text: Old Soviet and Turkish sofas are often sturdier than new ones: solid wood instead of chipboard. We strip the upholstery to the frame, replace everything soft and sew a new cover from a pattern. Over 300 fabric samples: velour, matting, jacquard and scratch-resistant cloth for homes with cats. The master brings samples to your home and quotes on the spot.

items.title: Master’s visit
items.text: Free, with fabric samples; price on the spot.

items.title: Pickup
items.text: Movers collect the furniture on a day that suits you.

items.title: Workshop
items.text: Stripping, frame repair, new foam, sewing.

items.title: Delivery
items.text: We deliver and place it; you pay after inspection.

items.quote: Grandma’s sofa from the eighties now looks better than a shop one and sits just like before.
items.author: Nargiza

items.quote: Six chairs in a week, and the cat no longer shreds the upholstery.
items.author: Rustam

items.q: Can I bring my own fabric?
items.a: Yes, we price the labour separately — 25% less than the price with fabric.

items.a: About 20% cheaper, but we recommend replacing foam older than 10 years.
